qualification: Signed v1.0.12-public-review.1 from 877f712b9e61c1a3208038024c609c2577347219, firmware SHA-256 dcd665f09dfe1f8d4b993799632d9830b6afafa4a209ffc43307596758ea5e93. On COM56 the installed bytes and running ELF matched, and partition metadata was preserved. Tests exercised manual and automatic full-resolution stills, microphone-on 480p and silent 720p clips, Photos display and playback to EOF, recorder capture, and read-only Public OTA selection.
